characters.name: 초롱꼬리 뿔쥐
characters.role: 작은 점프와 꼬리 유인으로 기본 타이밍을 익히는 적
characters.hook: 마검의 잔향에 반응하는 초롱 모양 꼬리
characters.motions: 두리번거리기, 짧은 도약, 꼬리 흔들기, 피격, 넘어짐
characters.appearance: A small feral forest rodent with a low pear-shaped gray-brown body, four short sturdy paws, oversized angular ears folded backward, one short blunt horn on the nose. Its long flexible tail curls over the back and ends in a hollow acorn-shell lantern with a SMALL warm amber seed glow inside. Bark-colored bristles on its back, pale oat muzzle, sharp attentive small eyes, not cute mascot eyes. Tail lantern is an actual organic acorn pod, not a light bulb or fireball. A few dried leaf tufts on shoulders. Silhouette strongly reads as a unique low rodent with a raised tail-lantern; all four paws and entire curled tail visible. Left-facing sniffing ready pose. Small rural woodland enemy, not a humanoid.

characters.name: 등갑가시 멧돼지
characters.role: 몸을 낮추는 예고 뒤 직선으로 돌진하는 적
characters.hook: 몸을 보호하는 도토리 껍질 같은 등갑
characters.motions: 숨 고르기, 앞발 긁기, 돌진, 제동, 피격
characters.appearance: A compact powerful woodland boar with four short articulated legs and a broad wedge-shaped snout aimed left. Its back has three overlapping dark acorn-shell bark plates with small root thorns growing backward, like a natural shoulder shield rather than metal armor. Two asymmetrical ivory lower tusks, one chipped, black-brown wiry fur and warm russet cheeks. Thick powerful front shoulders, lower hindquarters and a short curled vine tail. No rider, saddle or accessories. Hooves grounded, head lowered in a readable pre-charge ready stance, not charging yet. Silhouette needs readable tusks and layered back armor, not a generic realistic pig.

characters.name: 포자주머니 삿갓꾼
characters.role: 거리를 두고 포자 덩어리를 던지는 적
characters.hook: 버섯 갓의 아가미와 허리의 포자 주머니
characters.motions: 갓 들썩임, 뒤뚱걷기, 주머니 꺼내기, 투척, 쪼그라짐
characters.appearance: A squat two-legged mushroom-folk creature, not a human in a mushroom hat. The broad slanted rusty-ochre cap is part of its body and lifts at the left rim to reveal dark layered gills and two tiny recessed amber eyes within the gills, not a cute face on a white stalk. A short woven-mycelium torso, two twiglike arms, two thick root feet. Three round olive spore sacks grow from a natural cord around its waist; one short hand holds one sack at its side, not thrown. Cap has restrained cream speckling, a chipped irregular edge, dark moss beneath. Clear simple arm/leg joints, no extra limbs, readable small ranged-thrower silhouette, facing left.

characters.name: 철침날개 나방
characters.role: 공중에서 머뭇거리다가 사선으로 파고드는 적
characters.hook: 봉인못 문양이 박힌 두꺼운 앞날개
characters.motions: 정지 비행, 날개 접기, 급강하, 회피, 추락
characters.appearance: An original large night moth hovering facing left, with one slim charcoal-gray segmented body, two feathery antennae, six small tucked insect legs, and exactly FOUR wings in two clear paired layers. Its two large forewings look like aged dark leaf plates edged with rusty iron; each has one long brass-colored seal-pin embedded diagonally as a structural rib. Smaller hindwings muted dusty teal, wing markings resemble interrupted veins and narrow notches rather than eye spots. Small pale amber eyes, fur collar around thorax. Wings held half-open with every tip inside frame, abdomen and legs visible, no pollen clouds. Not a butterfly fairy, not a bat, no human face.

characters.name: 옹이덫 뿌리늑대
characters.role: 낮게 달려들고 뿌리 발톱으로 진로를 압박하는 적
characters.hook: 옹이 구멍 같은 주둥이와 갈라진 나무 발
characters.motions: 경계, 낮은 달리기, 도약 물기, 뿌리 긁기, 무너짐
characters.appearance: A lean wolf-shaped woodland construct assembled from interwoven dark oak roots and bark, with exactly four articulated canine legs. Its muzzle is a split hollow wood knot with pale root teeth, a single dull amber eye in the visible left-facing side, not a skull. Ridged bark shoulders, thinner woven-root waist, moss patches over shoulder blades, short pine-needle tufts along neck. Each paw is a visibly separate three-pronged woody root foot. Tail is a flexible bundle of roots curving low, entirely visible. Natural dark brown, sage moss, desaturated ivory roots. Alert low stalking ready pose, ears made of short bark fins, no antlers or rider, no huge spell effects.

characters.name: 금간종 가면도적
characters.role: 가루를 던져 시선을 끈 뒤 짧게 접근하는 적
characters.hook: 금이 간 나무 가면과 허리의 작은 유리종
characters.motions: 경계, 옆걸음, 가루 투척, 짧은 베기, 항복 또는 쓰러짐
characters.appearance: A wiry human roadside scavenger bandit, a distinct enemy adult rather than our boy hero. Short dark hair under an asymmetrical patched olive hood, a cracked plain walnut-wood half-mask covering nose and upper cheeks with an angular horizontal slit, no skull motif. Faded olive-brown short jerkin, rolled gray sleeves, mismatched leather gloves, narrow trousers and clear worn ankle boots. A small cracked GLASS BELL hangs from the waist next to a stoppered powder pouch. One hand holds a short hooked iron utility blade low and outward facing left; the other rests near the powder pouch. No blue cape, long sword or heroic pose. Grounded side-facing crouched-ready posture, both hands and boots visible, no particles. Design suggests a desperate scavenger who could surrender, not a demonic armored knight.

characters.name: 깨진항아리 집게
characters.role: 평범한 항아리처럼 숨었다가 뚜껑을 열고 집는 적
characters.hook: 금 간 봉인 항아리가 껍질인 집게 생물
characters.motions: 위장 정지, 뚜껑 들기, 옆걸음, 집게 치기, 파손
characters.appearance: An original pottery hermit-crab mimic. One cracked round smoky-blue ceramic storage jar is its shell, with an old three-notch geometric seal stamped into the clay, NO readable writing. A crooked broken lid is lifted slightly, revealing two small recessed warm eyes and a dark crab mouth. Exactly four short crustacean walking legs and two asymmetric pincers made from bent rusty iron pot-handle shapes emerge beneath the jar. Larger left-facing pincer open enough to read the hinge; smaller pincer tucked at side. Earthy gray-blue glaze, chipped warm clay edges, a little moss in cracks. Whole creature and all leg tips visible, squat sideways ready pose. No treasure chest, coin pile, tentacles or human limbs.

characters.name: 사슬팔 무덤병
characters.role: 사슬 추를 크게 예고한 뒤 휘두르는 중거리 적
characters.hook: 봉인 묘비 조각과 사슬로 이어진 팔
characters.motions: 끌며 걷기, 사슬 들어 올리기, 추 휘두르기, 균형 회복, 붕괴
characters.appearance: A narrow reanimated tomb sentinel, humanoid with two legs and two arms, wrapped in weathered charcoal and sand-colored burial cloth under sparse broken bronze plates. Its face is a flat eroded stone burial mask with one vertical recessed amber slit, no realistic corpse flesh or gore. A small broken headstone slab is strapped along its back, not taller than its head. One forearm ends in a short chain of exactly five thick iron links connected to a blunt engraved stone weight, held hanging close enough to show the chain mechanism; the other hand has stiff articulated fingers. Distinct feet and knee joints under torn cloth, left-facing guarded stance. No extra floating chains, skull crown or huge smoke.

characters.hook: 돌책을 접은 듯한 어깨와 한쪽 방패팔
characters.motions: 대기, 무거운 보행, 방패 들기, 밀치기, 금 가며 무너짐
characters.appearance: A squat bipedal stone-book construct, not an ordinary human knight. Its torso is a heavy shut stone ledger with a thick vertically ridged spine, broad engraved limestone shoulders resembling folded book covers, a tiny recessed head with one dark triangular glass lens. Two articulated legs of stacked stone blocks, two arms: the LEFT-facing forearm is a single broad rectangular stone-cover shield with a clipped outer corner; the other arm is short and ends in a three-finger stone hand. Sparse worn bronze hinges and dusty teal seal strips, no legible runes or floating books. Whole body in a defensive half-turn toward left, clear gaps at shoulders, elbows, hips and knees for future animation. No sword, no extra limbs.

Design brief:
A squat bipedal stone-book construct, not an ordinary human knight. Its torso is a heavy shut stone ledger with a thick vertically ridged spine, broad engraved limestone shoulders resembling folded book covers, a tiny recessed head with one dark triangular glass lens. Two articulated legs of stacked stone blocks, two arms: the LEFT-facing forearm is a single broad rectangular stone-cover shield with a clipped outer corner; the other arm is short and ends in a three-finger stone hand. Sparse worn bronze hinges and dusty teal seal strips, no legible runes or floating books. Whole body in a defensive half-turn toward left, clear gaps at shoulders, elbows, hips and knees for future animation. No sword, no extra limbs.

Clear humanoid anatomy, restrained angular silhouette, no cone helmet or religious symbol, no spell effects or floating minions.

Asset: ONE original monster-character CUTSCENE KEY ART / full-body appearance reference for the original 2D side-scrolling medieval fantasy game Demon Sword Simulator. This is ONE still pose of ONE monster, NOT an animation sheet, NOT a lineup, NOT multiple views.
Input image 1 is ONLY the ART-STYLE reference of our existing boy hero: match its detailed hand-pixelled 2D fantasy rendering, dark readable contour, restrained clustered highlights, earthy material colors. Do NOT copy the boy, his blue cape, clothing, body or sword into this creature.
Render a single newly designed character in a clear combat-ready resting pose, facing LEFT in near-side elevation with only slight three-quarter visibility so its anatomy can later be animated. Camera at character height. Clearly hand-drawn 2D pixel-art character illustration, visible crisp pixel clusters, roughly 2-3px logical pixel marks on a square approximately1024x1024 canvas. No 3D miniature, realistic 3D lighting, isometric view, shiny plastic, photorealism, chibi redesign, blur or painterly smears.
Full head, limbs, feet, wings, tail, clothing and every weapon must be fully inside the canvas with at least10% transparent margin. Keep joints and held weapons readable and separate from the face. No extreme foreshortening. One character occupies about70-78% of the frame's longest dimension. Entire body visible, both feet visible for bipeds, no cropping.
A truly clear transparent RGBA background, alpha0 outside the character. No scenery, ground slab, cast shadow, decorative frame, labels, letters, HUD, grid, spark clouds or additional characters. No brown haze, background wash, backlight cloud or diffuse aura outside the silhouette. Isolated die-cut character, exterior pixels fully alpha0. Very subtle emission only where specified, otherwise no attack effects. Purpose is a stable identity reference for future sprite animations. No gore.
Design brief:
A massive original altar-sentinel boss, an articulated biped assembled from aged pale limestone altar slabs, exactly two arms and two legs. Large broad shoulder blocks are hinged with tarnished brass, a small recessed wedge-shaped head, one narrow subdued blue-gray glass eye. The torso has one inset circular stone seal with a missing upper wedge, a quiet dark recess rather than a neon core. Long dull burgundy ceremonial stonecloth panels stop above the knees so hips and leg joints are clear. In BOTH hands holds ONE enormous short-handled rectangular SEAL-STAMP HAMMER: block head with a simple deeply carved three-notch motif on the bottom, no readable text, poised angled down-left. Huge planted articulated feet, weighty yet animateable joints. Different from a round rock monster or an ordinary knight, no floating slabs, magic rings or background altar.

characters.name: 로한, 마검 회수단장
characters.role: 창으로 검을 걸어 끌어오고 빈틈을 찌르는 회수대장 후보
characters.hook: 검을 회수하는 갈고리 창과 열린 왕실 칼집
characters.motions: 지휘 자세, 전진, 갈고리 준비, 당기기, 찌르기, 경직
characters.appearance: An original demon royal recovery commander, tall disciplined adult humanoid with two arms two legs and a human-like angular ash-gray face, short charcoal hair visible behind a black-iron open-sided officer helmet. Helmet has a SINGLE broad short brow crest shaped like a split crown, not giant horns. Asymmetrical ivory-enamel left pauldron over black iron plate, deep muted burgundy half-cape only behind the back, aged brass fasteners, articulated knees and boots visible. Holds ONE long thick retrieval lance with a FORKED hooked blade-catching head aimed left; one tine is shorter and chipped. A large ornate EMPTY royal scabbard is worn at the hip, the hollow mouth clearly visible. Calm authoritative guard stance, lance held away from face, clear hand grips. No actual stolen demon sword, no blue outfit, no magic trails, no 3D armor figurine.

characters.name: 쇠비룡, 왕관을 삼킨 수호수
characters.role: 돌진·날개 밀치기·긴 꼬리로 넓은 거리를 압박하는 보스 후보
characters.hook: 금속 조각을 비늘처럼 품은 낮은 비룡
characters.motions: 낮은 경계, 기어가기, 날개 펼치기, 돌진, 꼬리 공격, 쓰러짐
characters.appearance: An original low crouching castle wyvern boss, clearly animal rather than armored human. Exactly TWO massive wing-forelimbs with visible elbow and wrist claws, and TWO strong hind legs, no additional pair of front legs. Long narrow beak-like iron-plated muzzle aimed left, small amber eyes, one short chipped limestone brow horn. Overlapping dull charcoal iron and slate scales incorporate a few swallowed aged-brass CROWN FRAGMENTS along neck and shoulders, no actual crown worn on head. Partly spread leathery wings supported by simple iron-gray finger struts; deep desaturated burgundy wing membranes, fully visible wing tips. Muscular long tail ends in a broad blunt gripping pincer shape, not a sword blade. Whole body, all four limb structures, wing tips and tail in a square frame with wide margins. Restrained natural materials, no fire breath, electric glow, rider or architectural background.

characters.motions: 위엄 있는 대기, 절제된 보행, 칼집 타격, 마력 집중, 연속 공격, 패배
characters.appearance: FINAL DEMON KING appearance key art, original named Varken, the king whose world-strongest demon sword has been lost and found by our boy hero. A tall imposing adult male humanoid with exactly two arms two legs, dignified stern angular ash-gray face, short coal-gray hair, small ancient amber eyes, and ONE broken natural horn at his right temple. Wears an OPEN-CENTER black-iron crown with three broad uneven prongs, large simple charcoal armor plates, one broad ivory-enamel shoulder guard, aged bronze belt and restrained deep wine-red mantle split into three unequal panels. Distinct articulated knees and dark boots visible beneath mantle, no blue trench coat or silver long hair. His left hand rests on ONE long clearly EMPTY royal greatsword SCABBARD held upright beside him like a blunt staff; the open hollow mouth near shoulder MUST visibly contain NO blade. Right hand held forward in a calm open empty palm, fingers readable, only a tiny pale violet mark on palm, no giant magic effects. The empty scabbard and empty sword hand are the defining story symbols. Ready to fight without his stolen sword, majestic composed menace rather than a screaming giant demon. Full body, crown, horn, mantle and entire scabbard visible with generous margin. Rich high-quality 2D pixel clusters matching the supplied hero but more imposing, no throne, background, defeated hero, extra weapon, flames or skull piles.
